compilerProducesToday.typedRecords: Yes: KnowledgeRecord with Kind (Requirement, Decision, Hypothesis, Evidence, Experiment, Theory, ResearchPackage, Journal, ResearchQuestion, Governance, Method, Verification, Document, Other), typed relations (supports, contradicts, depends_on, supersedes, superseded_by, derived_from, related_to, mentions), qualitative Confidence, Provenance (src/Echelon.KnowledgeStore.Core/Model.fs:1-75). Kind inferred from directory then ID prefix (RQ, DF/ADR, EV, HY, EX, TH, RP, JR, GV, VR...) (Model.fs:78-125).
compilerProducesToday.typedRequirements: Requirements parsed as records; acceptance criteria extracted from '## Acceptance' list; `eks obligations ID` emits eks.requirement-contract/0 with obligations (all classified 'human', MechanicallyTestable=false in fixture run unless `verified_by` bindings declared).
compilerProducesToday.diagnostics: 27 codes EKS0001-EKS0027, levels Error/Warning/Advisory/RequiresReview, file(line), remediation text (Diagnostics.fs). Examples: EKS0001 missing id, EKS0002 dangling ref, EKS0006 cycle, EKS0008 vendored copies, EKS0009 no acceptance, EKS0013 superseded without replacement, EKS0015 instructions to agents in record text, EKS0017 contested claim, EKS0022 misspelled field, EKS0027 non-existent source.
compilerProducesToday.packages: `context`, `evidence`, `impact`, `explain`, `work-item` Markdown packages with header (compiler version, inputs hash, as-of, status COMPLETE/INCOMPLETE, authority statement), record text fenced as data; `manifest`/`work-item-manifest` JSON with derived completeness conditions.
compilerProducesToday.provenanceAndVersionIds: Per-record sha256 of source file; inputs hash in header; manifest.json lists every input path+sha256; source revisions from .git HEAD; compiler name/version 'eks-compiler 0.1.0-research'; `verify` refuses stale artefacts (exit 2).
compilerProducesToday.contradictionDetection: Partial: contested-claim (EKS0017) when a record has both supports and contradicts evidence; supersession authority/asymmetry (EKS0021); EKS0008 divergent vendored copies; `explain` derives current authority. No semantic/prose contradiction detection (findings/unresolved-questions.md 'Status vs prose contradictions').
compilerProducesToday.compileArtifacts: `eks compile --out DIR` writes index.md, records.jsonl, diagnostics.json, precomputed.json, manifest.json (observed this run).
compilerProducesToday.changeControl: `diff` and `change-manifest` (eks.change-manifest/0; exit 4 if rejected, otherwise requires-review; never approves).

[measured] Compiler: 36 -> 3 true errors on public corpus after calibration; 22/26 agent-edit mutations caught; cold <0.4 s, warm ~0.05 s

researchArtifactFormat.missionFolder: research/<YYYY>-<topic>/ with README.md (mission ID 'EKS-RESEARCH-2026-00N', question, short answer, status, contents table, reproducing commands)
researchArtifactFormat.subfolders: baseline/, architecture/, benchmarks/, experiments/ (results md + raw/ with every score/usage/assignment), evidence-integrity/, knowledge-updates/, security/, strategy/ (executive-report.md, recommendations, roadmap), findings/ (accepted/rejected ideas, unresolved-questions.md), evidence/ (CSV registers), continuation/
researchArtifactFormat.machineReadable: continuation/research-status.json (schema 'eks.research-status/1': mission, status, asOf, branch, pullRequest, baseline SHAs, headline, completionCriteria, gates, openRisks) and continuation/continuation-manifest.json (schema 'eks.continuation-manifest/1': resumeFrom, nextQuestions[priority, question, design], pendingOwnerDecisions, commands)
researchArtifactFormat.evidenceCsvs: claims-and-evidence.csv (claim_id CL-NNN, claim, status, evidence, measured_or_hypothesis, reproduce); contradictions.csv (CX-NNN ...); source-register.csv (SRC-<AREA>-NNN, title, url, type, accessed, used_for, workstream)
researchArtifactFormat.frontMatter: Research report .md files in EKS have NO YAML front matter (plain '# Title'); every claim labelled [measured]/[hypothesis] with reproducing command (AGENTS.md rule 5). Knowledge RECORDS (what the compiler reads) use YAML front matter: id, title, status, created, relation lists (supports, contradicts, depends_on, supersedes, superseded_by), source_uri, optional verified_by; IDs '<PREFIX>-<REPO>-<NNNN>' e.g. RQ-FXL-0004, filename '<ID>--<slug>.md' in research/{requirements,decisions,evidence,hypotheses,experiments,...}; acceptance criteria under '## Acceptance'; cross-repo refs 'repo:ID'.
researchArtifactFormat.governance: Branch claude/<task> or research/<topic>, PR with template stating measured results; never force-push; fantomas --check; no migrations of other repos' knowledge
